title: Second Light
author: Hallam Knight
tagline: A new world. A second chance. Or a second mistake?
blurb:
Proxima b was meant to be a fresh start: a new home, a new future and proof that humanity can live beyond Earth.

But as the settlement takes shape beneath an alien sky, the TSV Meridian returns with answers to the Rounding Error... and more questions than it solves.

Strange signals, unexpected readings and a discovery beneath the surface hint that Proxima b may not be as uninhabited as they believed.

For the crew and colonists, the second light of a new world brings opportunity, hope, and the unsettling realisation that they may not be the first to call it home.

Some worlds aren't empty. They're just waiting.
